versions.subject: Merge PR #5860 from @marcopedrinazzi - Add New Email Forwarding and Hiding Rules
versions.detection:
selection_cmdlet:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'New-InboxRule'
        - 'Set-InboxRule'
        - 'Set-Mailbox'
selection_params:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'ForwardAsAttachmentTo'
        - 'ForwardingAddress'
        - 'ForwardingSmtpAddress'
        - 'ForwardTo'
        - 'RedirectTo' # Also covers "RedirectToRecipients"
condition: all of selection_*
